info.name: VetClinic API
info.description:
API collection for Veterinary Clinic Management System.

## Authentication
All endpoints except `/auth/token` require a Bearer token. Use the "Get Token" request first to obtain an access token, then set it as a collection variable or use the "Bearer Token" auth type.

## Multi-tenancy
The JWT token contains a `clinic_id` claim that automatically scopes all data operations to the authenticated user's clinic.

request.description:
Get access token from Keycloak using password grant.

**Default credentials:**
- Username: `user`
- Password: `user`

The response includes `access_token` which is automatically saved to the collection variable for use in other requests.
